title: Al-Wakil: The Divine Name Behind the Word Tawakkul
excerpt: Al-Wakil occurs 24 times in the Quran, and it shares its root with tawakkul. In ordinary Arabic a wakil is an agent — the person you appoint to handle a matter you cannot handle yourself.
seo_title: Al-Wakil: Meaning of the Divine Name in the Quran
seo_description: Al-Wakil appears 24 times in the Quran and shares its root with tawakkul. What the name means, and why reliance is an appointment rather than a mood.
